summary: Removed the fixed-seed call that made the SecureRandom output deterministic (CWE-336). SecureRandom is left to self-seed from the platform's entropy source, so nextInt() still produces usable random values and the feature (writing two random integers) is preserved.

edits.new:
SecureRandom secureRandom = new SecureRandom();

        IO.writeLine("" + secureRandom.nextInt());
